title: Saudi Arabian Flatbread
description: A traditional Saudi flatbread, perfect for snacking or as a side dish. Soft, lightly spiced and aromatic.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add flour, salt, black pepper, and cumin to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal portions, depending on the desired size.
Roll each portion into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Brush the tops with olive oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake the flatbreads for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
